title: A working answer with zero keys: local model is the default path
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. With no cloud key at all, missions run on the local model and say so once, including how to add a cloud key for harder work. Tests zc_local_first_default_*.
